By maintaining a high <cite id="1">97.3% program expense ratio</cite> in FY2025, the central administration ensures that the majority of operational capital directly funds member center programs. This administrative structure is backed by sound fiscal health, including <cite id="1">9.2 months of working capital</cite> held in reserve, providing organizational resilience for partner institutions.
rich_narrative.summary: Islamic Community of North America Bosniaks (ICNAB) provides crucial institutional and financial management support to Bosniak Islamic centers across North America. In FY2025, the organization reported <cite id="3">$3,851,438 in total revenue</cite>, reflecting its established role in coordinating regional religious infrastructure. The group spends a high portion of its budget on services, achieving a <cite id="1">97.3% program expense ratio</cite> in FY2025. This focus on direct organizational support allows member centers to maintain facilities and deliver local community programs. Financial operations show strong stability, backed by <cite id="1">9.2 months of working capital</cite> in reserve. However, revenue trends require monitoring, as contributions <cite id="3">declined 6% from $4,520,145 in FY2023 to $4,243,273 in FY2024</cite>.
